# Blackbook Protocol Advisor MCP

Public listing for the [Blackbook Protocol Advisor](https://theblackbook.pro) remote MCP server.

Connect MCP clients to `https://theblackbook.pro` (Streamable HTTP + OAuth). `/mcp` is also an alias.

This repository is the GitHub-backed listing for the [MCP Registry](https://github.com/mcp). Product source stays in the private Blackbook app.
